title.rendered: Pre Kindergarten coming to Middleton for 2022 –  2023

content.rendered:
We are excited to announce we will be offering a new half-day pre-kindergarten program here at Middleton Elementary beginning in the 2022-2023 school year. Our program will mirror our current programs at Ridges and Hawks View Elementary. The program will be inclusive, providing rich early learning opportunities for typically developing children and children with developmental delays and disabilities. This is a tuition-based program, with financial assistance available for families that qualify.

Applications are now being accepted. There are 20 spots available at each location. Please visit our Pre-Kindergarten webpage for more information and to register.
